businessDefinition: Number of defect events found per 100 inspected units.
eligiblePopulation: Valid inspection events and their governed inspected-unit exposure
zeroNullErrorPolicy: 0 defects with positive exposure is zero; zero exposure is N/A; defects with zero exposure is INVALID

businessDefinition: Share of inspected units with at least one qualifying defect.
eligiblePopulation: Unique inspected units in governed inspections
aggregationRule: COUNT(DISTINCT DefectiveUnitID) / COUNT(DISTINCT InspectedUnitID) at the governed perimeter
zeroNullErrorPolicy: 0 defective with positive exposure is zero; zero exposure is N/A; numerator greater than denominator is INVALID

businessDefinition: Availability multiplied by performance multiplied by quality for the governed equipment production window.
eligiblePopulation: Governed planned production windows for in-scope equipment
aggregationRule: Recompute components from base totals at target perimeter, then multiply
zeroNullErrorPolicy: Missing component is MISSING; invalid denominator in component is INVALID; do not coalesce to zero

businessDefinition: Absolute forecast error as a share of total actual magnitude for one frozen forecast evaluation window.
eligiblePopulation: Actualized observations belonging to the governed frozen forecast horizon
aggregationRule: SUM absolute errors / SUM absolute actuals
zeroNullErrorPolicy: Actual base below materiality floor is N/A according to definition; missing frozen forecast is MISSING

businessDefinition: Eligible media cost per 1,000 governed impressions.
eligiblePopulation: Governed paid-media spend and matched impressions in the same campaign/channel window
zeroNullErrorPolicy: Zero impressions with positive cost is INVALID; zero cost with positive impressions is zero; zero/zero is N/A

businessDefinition: Period sales units divided by period sales units plus ending inventory units for the same partner/product perimeter.
eligiblePopulation: Partner/product combinations with governed sell-out flow and period-end inventory
aggregationRule: Recompute from summed sales flow and compatible ending balance at the target perimeter; never sum percentages over time
zeroNullErrorPolicy: Sales=0 and ending inventory>0 gives zero; both zero is N/A
